_doc: Genes that have not been shown to fire in any committed screen, and why.
The shape is `tools/inert_waivers.json`'s: a flat {tag: reason} map. Unlike
that file the reason is ENFORCED -- `tools/gene_fires.py` fails a waiver
shorter than 40 characters -- and a waiver goes STALE, failing the same
`--max 0` ratchet, the moment its gene is proven by a committed screen row
or leaves the gene tables. The list can only shrink.
Almost every entry here is grandfathered: it was in the tables before a new
gene had to show it fires. A gene added AFTER 2026-08-23 should not appear
here at all -- #2330 wrote rows for eighteen behaviours, the gate refused
four of them on their own probes, and those four were removed from the
To clear an entry: run a single-gene probe, which holds every other gene at
the baseline so any divergence is this gene alone, and commit the analysis --
-- then DELETE the entry here, or the stale-waiver check fails.

waivers.barbarian-capture-priority: A capturable Barbarian Settler or Scout in exact one-turn reach of one of our military units is a rare board state, and a 18-seat-pair single-gene probe did not produce one. Predates this gate (2026-08-23). Not proof it cannot fire -- 18 seat pairs bound a per-game firing rate only loosely, the same caveat `gene_census` puts on a low-`--games` pass -- so this is a request for a longer probe, not a verdict. Evidence: `docs/gene_screens/fires/barbarian-capture-priority.json`.
waivers.competition-victory-points: CANNOT FIRE, and it is this gate's worked example. It prices a scored competition's first place by the Diplomatic Victory Points it pays, and `native_competitions` is `false` in `GameOptions` with nothing in the screen setting it, so no competition is ever scored and the branch is never entered. It has held a genome bit since #2274 and its row in the 23,622-seat standard screen duly reads -0.01 pp / z -0.03. A 18-seat-pair single-gene probe left both arms byte-identical, as it must. The resolution is for the screen to enable competitions or for the gene to leave the tables; this waiver records the debt, it does not settle it. Predates this gate (2026-08-23). Not proof it cannot fire -- 18 seat pairs bound a per-game firing rate only loosely, the same caveat `gene_census` puts on a low-`--games` pass -- so this is a request for a longer probe, not a verdict. Evidence: `docs/gene_screens/fires/competition-victory-points.json`.
waivers.condemn-under-congress: Needs the World Congress to have condemned a heretic AND that heretic's carrier to be in reach while this seat is at peace with its owner; a 18-seat-pair single-gene probe did not produce that conjunction. Predates this gate (2026-08-23). Not proof it cannot fire -- 18 seat pairs bound a per-game firing rate only loosely, the same caveat `gene_census` puts on a low-`--games` pass -- so this is a request for a longer probe, not a verdict. Evidence: `docs/gene_screens/fires/condemn-under-congress.json`.
waivers.enhancer-for-the-corps: Predates this gate (2026-08-23) and has not been probed. It was added to the tables before a gene had to show it fires, and no committed screen has priced it yet -- it is in `HEURISTIC_GENE_RANKING.md`'s *Awaiting measurement* list. Clear this the moment any screen gives it a non-zero row, or with the single-gene probe in this file's header; the stale-waiver check then forces the entry out.
